scope:
Wall frame/body, audio property writes and deferred method dispatch slice.

Native AnimationPlayer and AudioStreamPlayer run against the original resources.
Only playing-property writes are forwarded through a logging setter. The wall's
original _shake body targets a camera-call recorder. Controlled-object scripts,
scene flags, physical contact, camera execution and audibility are not tested.
adapters: Original wall scene keeps all subresources/node properties except the two declared playing-property selectors; original script attachment targets isolated _shake-only bridge.
Original _shake method body unchanged, global service only records camera call. No controlled base scripts run.

Fresh native MP3 import, then apply original checked loop=false/offset=0 parameters directly to native resource; do not copy upstream .mp3str cache. Logging requested_playing setter forwards every write to native playing. Records commands only, not PCM clock or audibility.
Native manual AnimationPlayer default DEFERRED method mode; flush barrier queued behind pending calls. All other scene callbacks excluded.
